# SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level 14 fourth-combat-style-bonus-feat
# widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level-1..level-13
# hybrid chassis (tests/sd18_ranger_level13_widening.rs, the loop's most
# recent Ranger ceiling) to Ranger level 14 as chosen input only. It names
# selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It is
# the level-13 fixture with the class level bumped and one additional chosen
# selection, exercising the 14th-level "Combat style feat" grant (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd, the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror,
# and legacy.aonprd.com, all byte-for-byte identical):
#
#   choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_4:feat:improved_precise_shot
#     -- the FOURTH combat-style bonus feat, granted at 14th ranger level.
#        Unlike the 2nd/6th/10th-level grants, the PF1 Core Rulebook's own
#        Ranger Combat Styles tables (Archery and Two-Weapon Combat) do not
#        tabulate any NEW named feat options at the 14th-level tier (verified
#        independently against three primary sources: d20pfsrd's dedicated
#        Ranger Combat Styles page, the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com
#        RangerCombatStyles page, and a Paizo rules-forum thread on the same
#        question -- all three agree the printed Core Rulebook list stops
#        naming new options after 10th level; only later sourcebooks such as
#        the Advanced Player's Guide add named 14th/18th-level options, which
#        are out of SD-18's Core-Rulebook-only scope). This fixture therefore
#        names a feat already legal at an earlier tier (Improved Precise
#        Shot, from the 6th-level Archery list) purely as a raw chosen-input
#        string exercising the OPEN-ENDED recognition idiom (mirroring the
#        Favored Terrain/Quarry choice-recognition idiom, not the
#        closed-restricted-list idiom used for feats 1-3): the seam records
#        only that a fourth combat-style bonus feat slot was chosen, with no
#        restricted-list validation attempted at this tier and no mechanical
#        value fabricated.
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-13 fixture unchanged.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level14-sd18-fourth-combat-style-feat
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:14
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2:enemy:undead
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_2:feat:manyshot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_3:feat:shot_on_the_run
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_4:feat:improved_precise_shot
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain:terrain:forest
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_2:terrain:mountain
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target:terrain:first
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_3:terrain:swamp
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain_bonus_increase_target_2:terrain:first
choice=choice:ranger_hunters_bond:form:bond
choice=choice:ranger_quarry_target:enemy:humanoid_orc
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
